nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $\sigma$ be an index type, let $p \in R[x_s : s \in \sigma]$, and let $L$ and $L'$ be finite lists of indices in $\sigma$. The mixed differential of $p$ along the concatenation of $L$ followed by $L'$ equals the mixed differential along $L'$ of the mixed differential of $p$ along $L$.
nodes.title: Mixed differential along a concatenated list

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $\sigma$ be an index type, let $i \in \sigma$, let $L$ be a finite list of indices in $\sigma$, and let $p \in R[x_s : s \in \sigma]$. The mixed differential of $p$ along the list that starts with $i$ and continues with $L$ equals the mixed differential along $L$ of $p - \partial_i p$, where $\partial_i$ is the partial derivative with respect to $x_i$.
nodes.title: Mixed differential along a list with a given first index

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $\sigma$ be an index type, and let $p \in R[x_s : s \in \sigma]$. If two finite lists $L$ and $L'$ of indices in $\sigma$ are permutations of each other, then the mixed differentials of $p$ along $L$ and along $L'$ are equal.
nodes.title: The mixed differential ignores the order of the indices

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $\sigma$ be an index type, and let $p \in R[x_s : s \in \sigma]$. The mixed differential of $p$ along the empty list of indices is $p$ itself.
nodes.title: Mixed differential along the empty list

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $\sigma$ be an index type, and write $\partial_s$ for the partial derivative with respect to $x_s$ on the polynomial ring $R[x_s : s \in \sigma]$. For a finite list $(i_1, \dots, i_k)$ of indices in $\sigma$ (repetitions allowed) and a polynomial $p \in R[x_s : s \in \sigma]$, the mixed differential of $p$ along the list is $(1 - \partial_{i_k}) \cdots (1 - \partial_{i_1})\, p$:…
nodes.title: Mixed differential operator

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $i \in \sigma$, let $L$ be a finite list of indices in $\sigma$, and let $p \in R[x_s : s \in \sigma]$. Writing $\partial_i$ for the partial derivative with respect to $x_i$, the partial derivative $\partial_i$ of the mixed differential of $p$ along $L$ equals the mixed differential along $L$ of $\partial_i p$.
nodes.title: Partial derivatives commute with the mixed differential

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
